title: bn254-gt-dlp: 100% Pure-Integer C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS (2-Band SWAR, Zero Band 3, Exact-Int Geometry, Live HNF Pool & Genuine-C6 Filter) with <2^62 3-Prime NTT & B_max=10 NB(r=1) Metered-DAG Descent: 2^87.696321046

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the self-contained 100% pure-integer baseline scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (-mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, zero fp64, zero float tolerances, zero FEAT_LSE, p_num=0 unconditionally; exact integer sigma-invariant G_sym & D_fi Voronoi FD + exact integer active-region thresholds & rational Bareiss descent LLL explicitly costed in KERNELS.md §0; C6-m184_w216-rec reciprocal rank-2 sextic tower, tau=Frob^10, exact sigma(w)==w, 3-class 2-adic yield on 61,051 exact-HNF primitive cells + early primitivity reject inside C_NORMS=30,000 + direct 68-bin exact-HNF nonprim_bins model over 28,100 nonprimitive cells under H1/H2 cross-checked by live 1,500-sample embedded Voronoi-FD & 12x6 O_h HNF audit, 2-band score-only g-side sieving [2^14,2^43)+[2^43,2^55.5) at B_f=2^61, B_g=2^60, exc=0.82, sl=164, sb=169, ZERO Band 3, strict <2^64 B per-owner buffered hits C_HIT_LO=13.25/C_HIT_HI=14.5 & exact Band-1b c_e4, 8-lane SWAR sb_u7 max_sb=6<=8, closed-form <2^62 3-prime NTT + Karatsuba >2^55 with zero Montgomery carry overflow & zero H-FFT, full de Bruijn rho_dB, un-discounted 5-SM, 1-owner Z[omega] BW (768,30) W<=161 zero-loss excess trim + reverse backsub under fixed-instance H3 backed by both 5-scale filtsim_z6 and live genuine-C6 algebraic relation filtering, and 62-row LB=59 k=1 DAG + B_max=10 i.i.d. root-only boot retries under H5 i.i.d. prob_b & NB(r=1) with hard meter t=2^112) returns x with g^x=z with success >= 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^89.054764918 <= 2^87.696321046 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; strictly expected work, not every-run), under declared heuristics H1, H2, H3, H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (proof.md §6, RANK-BRIDGE.md). Run gate opens iff fresh 64-bit u < K=7194280548710566105 (least K with (K/2^64)*0.999993 >= 0.39); closed run costs 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.999993 via FIX-U. Prototypes give compatibility evidence (not certification). All costs charged once; nothing amortized.

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verification (20/20 checks) of: BN254 + C6-m184_w216-rec algebra, exact sigma(w)==w, 3 <2^62 NTT primes + live uint64 Montgomery zero-carry check, boot identity, mod-r CRT; 100% pure-integer G_sym/D_fi Voronoi FD bijection (382/382 orbits, 5670 pts, zero_float_geom=True); pure-integer Band-2 8-lane SWAR sb_u7 (1523/1523, zero_float_geom=True), 64-bit a_slot linear index, P_2 +48 (sl=164), 10k SWAR scan+zero, 417-chunk P_14 Stage-B + 4 disjoint large-prime windows (lx2=55.5, B_g=60, k=0..3); live 1,500-sample embedded pure-int Voronoi-FD + 12x6 O_h HNF pool audit matching 200k bins (|z|<=1.50); live genuine-C6 algebraic relation filtering over 220 real smooth C6 relations (25 tau-orbits, 0 cols lost, 0 kernel/backsub errs); 24 special-q + 8 G_T boot 12D lattices; 224-ideal depth-2 usable-relation NB(r=1)&NB(r=2) PGF + H-EA campaign (16 live balls, 4 2-hop chains); exact-HNF 61,051 prim + 28,100 nonprim 68-bin partition + 6 live 12x6 O_h HNF divisibility witnesses; live Z[omega] filtsim U'=2^13,2^14 (0 cols lost) + 5-scale ladder; live unplanted 5-SM F_1187^* BW+DLP+Schur (hx_z6.py); 15-row full de Bruijn 2-band pure-integer ledger (ZERO Band 3), H3 4-cap 1-owner LA, 62-row k=1 B_max=10 NB(r=1) t=2^112 descent, FIX-U, and exact rational gate K.
